stories.title: AUSL All-Star Cup — Series 3 Complete, Klingler Leads Into Series 4
stories.angle: Series 3 closed Tuesday night with Team Klingler shutting out Team Palacios 1-0 — capping an unbeaten run for Baylee Klingler that has carried her to the top of the individual standings. Klingler is 4-0 all-time as an All-Star Cup captain and leads the individual race with 890 points. Lexi Kilfoyl is second at 866. Hannah Flippen sits third at 750. Kowalik — who led going into Series 3 — has dropped from the top spot. Four days until Series 4 (Aug 28-30) crowns the 2026 individual champion.

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Series 3 is done. Team Klingler shut out Team Palacios 1-0 to close it out — Baylee Klingler is 4-0 all-time as a captain. She leads the individual race 890-866 over Kilfoyl. Series 4 starts Friday. Champion crowned Aug 30. #AUSL 🥎

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Going into Series 4: Klingler 890 pts, Kilfoyl 866, Flippen 750. Klingler topped Kowalik who had led all series. Series 4 kicks off Friday Aug 28 at 7 PM ET on CBS Sports Network. Four days to the individual champion. #AUSL #WomensSoftball 🥎

article.headline: Series 3 Is Over. Klingler Leads 890–866 Over Kilfoyl. Series 4 Starts Friday.

stories.title: USA WNT — 17 Days to World Cup Group Stage
stories.angle: Seventeen days until USA Softball opens Group Oklahoma at Devon Park. Today's angle: the roster experience. Rachel Garcia and Dejah Mulipola are the two 2020 Olympians on the 16-player roster — veterans who have played in medal-round pressure before. With a group that includes Netherlands (No. 6) and Mexico (No. 7), that experience matters.

stories.title: Oklahoma — First Battle Series Scrimmage Complete
stories.angle: Oklahoma held its first public Battle Series scrimmage Friday night at Love's Field, drawing 2,351 fans. LSU transfer Sydney Berzon participated. Three takeaways from the first live look at the rebuilt Sooners roster. Public Battle Series events begin October 3.

stories.title: Teagan Kavan — Senior Season, 500 Career Ks, Three-Peat Bid
stories.angle: Texas ace Teagan Kavan heads into her senior season having already cleared 500 career strikeouts (milestone in April 2026 vs. Oklahoma). Her 2026 season: 2.33 ERA, 260 K, 228.2 innings. With Isa Torres (.530 BA, D1Softball POY) and a full Texas roster, the Longhorns are chasing what only UCLA (1988-90) and Oklahoma (2021-23) have ever done.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text: Teagan Kavan has 500 career Ks, two WCWS MVPs, and two national titles. Now she's back at Texas for her senior year chasing a three-peat — something only UCLA (1988-90) and OU (2021-23) have ever done. Fall camp is open. #HookEm 🤘
